martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, Sunday's looking great for a swim, especially between 18:00–20:00 when it's a pleasant 26°C. Not ideal for running, but who needs that when you can dive in and cool off? Drag Britt along for a sunset swim and make the most of this perfect evening.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Sunday funday and the swimming conditions are great, especially around 18:00–20:00 when it's a nice 26°C. Not the best day for cycling or running, but who needs that when you can dive into the lake? Maybe surprise Martha with a swim when she gets home, or just enjoy the calm evening on your own.
